practice.title: How do you want to practice?
practice.body: We pick every movement for your posture. You can change it anytime.
practice.body_relative: We pick every movement for their posture. You can change it anytime.

feel.title: What do you want to feel?
feel.title_relative: What do they want to feel?
feel.body: This sets the pace and the movements of your classes.
feel.body_relative: This sets the pace and the movements of their classes.

time.title: How much time a day?
time.body: A little every day beats a lot once in a while.

care.title: Any area to look after?
care.body: We adapt or skip the movements that load it.
care.safety: Manta doesn't replace your doctor. If something hurts, stop.

offline.title: Will you practice offline?
offline.body: In the park, out of town or traveling: Manta works without a connection.
offline.auto: Free classes download on their own over Wi‑Fi.
offline.manual: You can download any class whenever you like.

lesson.safety: Move without pain. If something hurts, stop.

player.voiceOnlyBody: Listen and move. Tap the screen to see the controls.
player.exitSaved: What you practiced stays in your logbook.

tutorial.speed: To go slower, tap the turtle at the bottom left.
tutorial.captions: If you'd rather just listen, tap the captions to hide them.
tutorial.pause: You can pause any time with the yellow button.

careNote.shoulders: Today we look after your shoulders: only raise your arms as far as feels comfortable.
careNote.back: Today we look after your back: move slowly and lean on the backrest if you need to.
careNote.knees: Today we look after your knees: steady feet and gentle turns, never forced.
careNote.wrists: Today we look after your wrists: keep them loose, without bending them.
careNote.neck: Today we look after your neck: small turns and a soft gaze, never forced.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Cabin mode: dark colors for practicing at night.
settings.hapticsHint: A soft pulse at the start of each in-breath, so you can practice with your eyes closed.
settings.reminderHint: One notification a day. Works without internet.
settings.storagePackaged: The free classes come inside the app and take no extra space.

health.title: Health note
health.body1: Manta offers gentle movements, but it doesn't replace a doctor or a physiotherapist.
health.body2: Always move without pain. If something hurts, stop and breathe.
health.body3: If you have an injury, recent surgery, dizziness or blood pressure problems, check with a health professional first.
health.body4: On a boat or anywhere that moves, practice seated or keep something to hold on to nearby.

notification.title: Your tide for today
notification.body: A few minutes of tai chi, wherever you are.
